Nafisat Abdulkareem, Film Editor

About

I'm Nafisat Abdulkareem, a film editor working across narrative films, documentaries, YouTube videos and other video projects.

My work goes beyond the edit. I also handle color grading, audio treatment, sound laying and finishing, including end credits. I pay attention to pacing, sound and color because those details can make a big difference in how a film feels.

I work with directors, producers and content creators from the first assembly through to the final export, taking each project through the different stages of post-production until it is ready to deliver.

Skills

What I actually focus on when I'm cutting a project.
01

Video & Film Editing

I build the assembly first, picking the right takes and trimming for intention, then shape the scene order so the story is easy to follow.

02

Pacing & Rhythm

I control the tempo scene to scene so tension, comedy or emotion land at the right moment, instead of just following the raw footage as shot.

03

Color Grading

I keep the visual tone consistent across a cut, matching shots to each other and using the grade to support the mood of the scene.

04

Audio Treatment

I clean up dialogue and balance levels so the audio supports the picture without pulling attention from it.

05

Sound Laying

I lay in music and sound effects, placing them carefully so the soundscape fits each scene.

06

Post-Production

I take a project through every stage after the shoot, from first assembly to a finished, deliverable film.

07

Finishing & Exporting

I design and build end credit sequences and final title cards, then export in the right format so a project is ready to deliver.

08

Collaboration & Notes

I work directly with directors and producers, taking their notes through each review round and turning them into real changes on the timeline.
